title: GhostPay
tagline: Send and receive crypto to anyone privately with just a link
description: GhostPay is a private payment dapp, allowing users to send and receive crypto to anyone privately, with just an URL instead of wallet address. No more asking and waiting for address, just send and be done in 30 seconds. Plus, users have the freedom to receive/claim crypto in any tokens they preferred.
how_its_made:
Railgun: We used Railgun SDK to enable private transaction between sender and receiver. and private swap. We also used Railgun Cookbook to enable private token swap on railway wallet for bot sender and receiver.

Peanut Protocol: We used Peanut SDK to send and receive funds with a link.
